known_prior_result.finding: The Generation 4 candidate beat SPY across both selection slices and survived cost and schedule stress, but failed deflated/statistical evidence, failed the frozen consistency test against static growth exposure, trailed QQQ, and could not pass authenticated all-symbol source reconciliation.

purpose: Run exactly five counted, literature-pinned Generation 5 formulas on the immutable Generation 4 panel. The family separates raw SPY advancement from the harder QQQ/static-growth-control advancement and forbids any post-output parameter or menu change.
claim_boundary: All market history, earlier search output, and the themes used to construct Generation 5 have been seen. Any pass is a retrospective model-comparison result only. It cannot establish future profitability, independent alpha, options profitability, or permission for live capital.

data.provider: Hash-pinned saved Generation 4 Yahoo Finance adjusted-close panel
data.null_policy: Use the immutable common-date panel exactly as frozen. Never forward fill, splice providers, add symbols, or refetch data.
data.bias_boundary: The adjusted-close series are revised and the 2026-surviving ETF menu, QQQ, formula family, horizons, trend filters, and development/validation dates were chosen after historical outcomes were known.

execution.signal_trade_return: close-t information -> queued close-t+1 execution -> first t+1-to-t+2 return
execution.standalone_boundaries: Every scored slice starts from BIL, charges entry turnover at the slice boundary, and charges final risky liquidation.
execution.deterministic_ties: Every numeric rank uses alphabetical ticker order for exact ties; strict trend and relative comparisons send equality to BIL or the stated fallback.

registered_formulas.formula: Every 21 sessions rebalance to 50% QQQ and 50% divided equally across XLK/XLF/XLE/XLY/XLP/XLI/XLB/XLV/XLU. This control isolates selection from a static QQQ-plus-sector allocation.

Every 21 sessions rank all 19 non-BIL panel ETFs by 252-session adjusted-close total return divided by annualized standard deviation of the 252 simple daily returns ending t. The top five receive fixed 20% slots; each slot is invested only when its asset is strictly above its inclusive 210-session SMA at t, otherwise that slot remains in BIL.

Every 21 sessions rank the original nine sectors by log(P[t-21]/P[t-252]). The top three receive fixed one-third slots; each slot is invested only when that sector is strictly above its inclusive 210-session SMA at t, otherwise that slot remains in BIL.

After 756 sessions, for each original sector fit excess log return on an intercept, SPY-minus-BIL, and QQQ-minus-SPY over daily return endpoints t-755 through t-252. Freeze those coefficients and score mean/sample-standard-deviation residuals over endpoints t-251 through t-21. Rank descending, take the top three, and hold them equally only when their mean 12-minus-1 BIL-excess log return is strictly above QQQ's; otherwise hold QQQ. Before complete history or on any invalid fit, hold QQQ.

Every 21 sessions admit SPY/IWM/EFA/EEM/IEF/TLT/GLD/DBC/VNQ whose 252-session log return is strictly above BIL's. Estimate each admitted asset's annualized volatility from all simple daily returns through t with normalized EWMA weights proportional to delta^lag, delta=60/61. Allocate inverse volatility and normalize risky gross to one; hold BIL when none qualifies or any required input is invalid.

trial_accounting.counting_boundary: The ineligible static control counts. Every registered formula counts even if it fails before selection; execution itself adds no further trial.

required: development annualized log-growth edge versus SPY is strictly greater than 0.50 percentage points
validation annualized log-growth edge versus SPY is strictly greater than 0.50 percentage points
development maximum drawdown is no more than five percentage points worse than SPY
validation maximum drawdown is no more than five percentage points worse than SPY
the consumed recent hard-safety veto does not fire
raw_spy.score: minimum development/validation annualized log-growth edge versus SPY

required: development and validation annualized log-growth edges versus QQQ are strictly positive
development and validation annualized log-growth edges versus static 50/50 SPY/QQQ are strictly positive
development and validation annualized log-growth edges versus static 50% QQQ plus equal sectors are strictly positive
the consumed recent hard-safety veto does not fire
growth_control.score: minimum of the six qualifying development/validation growth-control edges

selection_tracks.recent_veto: Veto when recent maximum drawdown is below -20%, recent total return trails BIL, or recent drawdown is over five percentage points worse than SPY. Recent history cannot rank, rescue, or break ties.

post_selection_robustness: replay the selected formula without search and preserve positive qualifying edges at 5/10/25 bp one-way costs
preserve positive qualifying edges across all 21 native rebalance anchors
apply deflated paired Sharpe evidence using at least 105 effective trials
apply shared-path circular and moving block maximum-statistic tests at frozen 5/20/60-session block lengths
report comparisons to QQQ, both static growth controls, the Generation 4 candidate, frozen Finly, SPY volatility targeting, and BIL
require a separately preregistered authenticated source-overlap PASS for every symbol used by the selected candidate
